```{r}
#plotting xu data of MEA expression after wounding


xu_timelapse <- read.csv("C:/Users/nsmoo/Desktop/Grad/RNA seq data/xu_timelapse/xu_timelapse.csv")
df <- data.frame(xu_timelapse$MEA, xu_timelapse$timepoint, xu_timelapse$pCL1)
df

library(ggplot2)

p <- ggplot(data = df, aes(x=xu_timelapse.timepoint, y=xu_timelapse.MEA, group=1)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  ylab("MEA") +
  xlab("time") + 
  ggtitle("MEA expression after wounding") + 
  ylim(0, 1) + 
  scale_x_discrete(limits=df$xu_timelapse.timepoint)


p + theme_classic()

ggsave("MEA expression after wounding.png", width=15, height=4.5)
```
```{r}
df.mea <- data.frame(MEA = xu_timelapse$MEA, 
                     timepoints = xu_timelapse$timepoint)
df.mea
df.cl1 <- data.frame(CL1 = xu_timelapse$pCL1, 
                     timepoints = xu_timelapse$timepoint)
df.cl1

both = merge(df.mea, df.cl1, by="timepoints")
both

both
df.melted <- reshape2::melt(both, id.var='timepoints')
df.melted
new <- na.omit(df.melted)
df.melted <- data.frame(new)
df.melted

p <- ggplot(df.melted, aes(x=timepoints, y=value, col=variable)) + geom_line()

p + theme_classic()

```
